Fello (Electron ACP Client)

Runtime
- Main process: src/electron/main.ts
- Preload (contextBridge): src/scripts/electron-preload/preload.ts
- Backend Logic (Node.js): src/backend/ (IPC handlers, ACP bridge, terminal manager, WebUI server, iLink bridge, skills catalog)
- Agent Session Logic (shared): src/agents/ (session-state, storage, OpenAI-compatible agent, MCP tools, ACP tools, permission memory, system prompts)
- Renderer (React + Vite): src/mainview/

IPC
- Typed contracts: src/shared/schema.ts (AgentInfo as discriminated union: StdioAgentInfo | ApiAgentInfo; McpServerInfo: StdioMcpServerInfo | HttpMcpServerInfo)
- Renderer API wrapper: src/mainview/backend.ts (uses window.fello or WebSocket fallback for WebUI)
- Electron-only native API: src/mainview/electron.ts (safely wraps window.fello calls)

Agent Architecture
- Two agent types supported:
  1. Stdio agents: spawned via child_process (src/backend/agent/stdio-agent.ts) communicating over NDJSON stdio via ACP SDK
  2. API agents: OpenAI-compatible HTTP API (src/backend/agent/openai-compatible-api-agent.ts) running in-process via @ai-sdk/openai-compatible
- Agent implementation: src/agents/openai-compatible-agent.ts implements the ACP Agent interface using the Vercel AI SDK (streamText, generateText)
- Agent process interface: src/backend/agent/base-agent.ts (AgentProcess: input WritableStream, output ReadableStream, close)
- ACP bridge: src/backend/agent/agent-bridge.ts manages agent process lifecycle & session routing

Built-in ACP Tools: src/agents/acp-client-tools.ts (ReadFile, WriteFile, EditFile, Shell, Plan, GetFileOutline)
- GetFileOutline: src/agents/file-outline.ts (AST file outline via @ast-grep/napi)

Sessions & Persistence
- Session metadata persistence: src/backend/storage.ts (stores SessionInfo including models, modes, initializeInfo, permissionMode, mcpServers)
- API agent session persistence: src/agents/storage.ts (stores session.json + history.jsonl under ~/.fello/api-agents/<agent_id>/sessions/<session_id>/)
- Fine-grained session updates: Uses `session-changed` IPC event to update single sessions atomically in the frontend store
- Permission memory: src/agents/permission.ts — supports "always allow" per tool kind, persisted in session state
- Auto session titles: OpenAI-compatible agent generates short titles on first user message via generateText
- MCP Server support: both Stdio (subprocess) and HTTP types, toggle per session
- Message history: persisted locally in messages.jsonl (ACP agents) or history.jsonl (API agents), enabling robust offline recovery
- Agent terminal outputs: persisted as .log files in the `terminals/` folder under each session's directory, automatically restored
- Renderer state store: src/mainview/store.ts (includes ilinkStatus, activeIlinkSessionId, isMacApp, isFullScreen)
- Routing: src/mainview/router.tsx (react-router-dom HashRouter with /settings/* and /skills/* nested routes)
- ChatMessage polymorphic interface: src/mainview/lib/chat-message.ts (supports ContentBlocks for text, image, audio, etc.)
- Content block rendering: src/mainview/components/content-blocks/
- Common Components: src/mainview/components/common/ (CodeView, CodeCompareView powered by @pierre/diffs, ImageView, AgentTerminalOutput, StreamMarkdown)
- Global Error Handling: src/mainview/components/global/error-boundary.tsx
- ACP events handling: src/mainview/lib/session-state-reducer.ts
- Chat input attachments: src/mainview/components/session/chat/chat-input.tsx (file picker + drag-and-drop; filters by agent promptCapabilities)
- Chat timeline dots + scroll tracking: src/mainview/components/session/chat/chat-area.tsx and src/mainview/components/session/chat/chat-timeline.tsx
- Chat header: src/mainview/components/session/chat/chat-header.tsx (agent badge, title, project path, MCP server toggle menu, refresh)
- Session view layout: src/mainview/components/session/session.tsx (ResizablePanelGroup 3-column: Chat + Detail + Panel, compact mode at < 1000px)
- Panel (tabbed): src/mainview/components/session/panel/panel.tsx (Files / Terminal tabs)
- File tree: src/mainview/components/session/panel/file-panel/file-panel.tsx (formerly file-panel.tsx — tree only, no embedded preview)
- Terminal tab list: src/mainview/components/session/panel/terminal-panel/terminal-panel.tsx (vertical terminal list, create/delete/switch)
- Detail view: src/mainview/components/session/detail/detail.tsx (dispatches to FilePreview or TerminalDetail)
- File preview: src/mainview/components/session/detail/file/file-detail.tsx (image, markdown, code, diff; close button)
- Terminal detail: src/mainview/components/session/detail/terminal/terminal-detail.tsx (full-size xterm.js, ResizeObserver auto-fit)
- Chat bubbles: src/mainview/components/session/chat/bubbles/ (agent, user, system, tool, thinking, plan)

iLink (WeChat) Integration
- Bridge: src/backend/ilink/ilink-bridge.ts (connection lifecycle, QR login, long-polling, message routing, typing indicators)
- HTTP Client: src/backend/ilink/ilink-client.ts (iLink REST API)
- Crypto: src/backend/ilink/ilink-crypto.ts
- Settings UI: src/mainview/components/settings/ilink/settings-ilink.tsx
- Persisted credentials: ~/.fello/ilink/credentials.json
- Active session tracking: ~/.fello/ilink/active-session.json

Skills System
- Catalog scanning: src/backend/skills.ts (user/project level, fello/agents/claude scopes)
- skills.sh marketplace integration: search & install
- UI: src/mainview/components/skills/ (skills-layout, installed/skills-installed, skills-sh/skills-skills-sh)
- Skill files stored under: ~/.fello/skills/, ~/.agents/skills/, ~/.claude/skills/

Dev / Build Commands
- npm run dev (electron-vite dev; Vite server on http://localhost:5173)
- npm run build
- npm run preview
- npm run pack:mac / pack:win / pack:linux
- npm run lint (oxlint)
- npm run typecheck (tsc for both renderer and node configs)
- npm run format (oxfmt)
- npm run prepare:icon:mac (icon generation script)

Repo Conventions
- Electron code lives under src/electron
- Backend logic lives under src/backend
- Agent session logic lives under src/agents (framework-agnostic, shared)
- UI code lives under src/mainview
- ScrollArea utility: src/mainview/components/ui/scroll-area.tsx (supports hideScrollBar to omit scrollbar rendering)
